programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: The secrets behind keeping the cars of Daytona on the track for 24 hours of racing are revealed. The sweetest sugarcane is turned into Caribbean rum.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: Giant sturgeons are farmed for the delicacy of Russian caviar. Workers create soccer cleats worn by the sport's greatest players.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: Danish bomb squads find and dispose of thousands of World War II landmines. Weed eaters chop down growth with just a sliver of nylon.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Treasure Troves. Hunting for rare treasures, the team visit a colourful collection of Americana, a historic shipping warehouse, and a huge indoor flea market in Wales.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard is in Staffordshire to get access to a private collection of a pub owner, who has been hoarding antiques for over half a century.

programme.desc: MGA. With Drew busy hunting for antiques, Paul heads to a classic car auction near the Malvern Hills. Paul sees big potential in a MGA 1600, even though it doesn't start up.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including stainless steel, football helmets, resin figurines and laboratory glassware.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: MGB Roadster. The boys mark the MGB's 60th anniversary in style by buying and fixing up one of these classic motors. But the upgrades come with hefty costs.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: BMW 2002tii. This BMW was more driver-focused and handled better than its contemporaries. Will Edd be able to resurrect a 1970s relic not started for two decades?

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Volvo Amazon 122. Mike is in the Pacific Northwest, where he has tracked down a true 'barn find': A Volvo Amazon 122 with a rally heritage. Ant is tasked with making it roadworthy.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Lamborghini Urraco. Mike heads out to Poland to bag a Lamborghini Uracco. However, the price of this classic is rising due to Lamborghini's 50th anniversary, can Mike bag a bargain?

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Saab 9-3. Mike wants a high performance car with an historic badge, but it's hard to find a Saab 9-3 Turbo at a good price. With tight margins will Edd have any room for manoeuvre?

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers: Stripped Down

programme.title: New: MotoGP

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: Vincent / Triumph 5TA. Henry and Fuzz sail over to the Isle of Wight. They meet Vince, a fanatical collector whose sheds are bursting with British and Japanese bikes.

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: Nick / Austin Champ. Henry and Fuzz are overwhelmed by Nick from Brackley's military collection. They leave with a vintage rarity, but will they find a buyer for something so unique?

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: David / Ducati. Henry and Fuzz rummage through David's hoard of Italian bikes in Norfolk. They're smitten by his Ducatis and his rare Mot Guzzis, but just what will he sell?

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: Kevin / Lincolnshire. Henry and Fuzz head to Lincolnshire to see Kevin's collection of vintage lorries and trucks. They find a Cornish fire engine, but is it too hot to handle?

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: Francis / Oxfordshire. Henry and Fuzz are staying local, visiting Francis' farm in Oxfordshire. There's tractors, bikes and trinkets, but what will they come away with?

programme.title: True agus Ríocht an Bhogha Ceatha

programme.desc: 1947. Crime drama. Directed by Oswald Mitchell and starring Anthony Hulme, Lesley Osmond and Frank Hawkins. A solicitors' clerk is sent to deliver a will and finds the recipient murdered.

programme.title: Up The River
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Directed by John Ford. Stars Spencer Tracy, Claire Luce & Humphrey Bogart. When a paroled convict and former inmate are blackmailed, two career criminals come to their rescue.

programme.title: Terror By Night
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Starring: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce & Alan Mowbray. When a diamond is stolen on a train and the son of its owner is murdered, everybody is a suspect to Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. Person Unknown. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Edward Cast and Alan Robinson. A Polish spy changed places with a would-be assassin. (S1, E18)

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Spider. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips & Donald Pleasence. Austrian commander 'The Spider' captures two of Tell's men and threatens to torture them. Now Tell must infiltrate The Spider's ranks.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: 1955. Western. Directed by Tim Whelan. Stars Randolph Scott, Forrest Tucker & Mala Powers. A private detective from Chicago is sent out west to take down the notorious Reno brothers.

programme.title: Out of the Fog
programme.desc: 1962. Crime drama directed by Montgomery Tully. An ex-con is the prime suspect when a series of murders occur under a full moon. Every victim is a blonde young woman. Starring David Sumner.

programme.title: Daily Sketch Jigsaw Puzzle 1938
programme.desc: Take a nostalgic trip back to 1938 with this short film about the Daily Sketch's jigsaw puzzle.

programme.title: Storm Over the Nile
programme.desc: 1955. Directors: Zoltan Korda & Terence Young. Stars Anthony Steel & Laurence Harvey. A British officer is accused of cowardice by his friends and woman he loves. He sets out to prove his courage.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Waverly Ring Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: A Point of Honour. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. An encounter with a young lady on a train leads to a strange weekend of mistaken identity and danger.

programme.title: An Englishman Abroad
programme.desc: 1983. Drama. Director: John Schlesinger. Stars Alan Bates, Coral Browne & Charles Gray. Based on a true story, actress Coral Browne has a chance meeting with a member of the Cambridge spy ring.

programme.title: Run Wild, Run Free
programme.desc: 1969. Drama. Directed by Richard C. Sarafian. Stars John Mills, Sylvia Syms & Gordon Jackson. A psychosomatically mute young boy finds an emotional release through his love for a wild white colt.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: 1981. Thriller. Directed by Richard Franklin. Stars Jamie Lee Curtis, Stacy Keach & Marion Edward. A truck driver in Australia begins to suspect that a man is killing young women along his route.

programme.title: The Big Lift
programme.desc: 1950. War drama starring Montgomery Clift. In 1948 the Soviet Union blockades the allied sectors of Berlin, to bring the entire city under their control.

programme.title: Glimpses - Far Away Places
programme.desc: Parkside Productions present The Malcolm Mitchell Group playing 'Far Away Places'. Directed by Roger Proudlock.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Come Back, Shame. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Cliff Robertson. Batman and Robin reckon something's up when Shame steals Grimaldi Smith's hot racing car in the middle of the Gotham City 500.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: It's How You Play the Game. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cliff Robertson & Eric Shea. Shame goes to work on his final caper - the theft of four prize cattle worth over one million dollars.

programme.title: Johnny On The Spot
programme.desc: 1954. Crime directed by Maclean Rogers. Johnny (Hugh McDermott) returns from a prison sentence to get the man who framed him.

programme.title: Girdle of Gold
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy directed by Montgomery Tully and filmed at Nettlefold. Starring Esmond Knight and Maudie Edwards. A husband hides a fortune in his wife's girdle, only for the girdle to go 'missing'.

programme.title: Hell's Angels
programme.desc: 1930. War. Director: Howard Hughes. Stars Ben Lyon, James Hall & Jean Harlow. Epic war film following the lives of two dissimilar brothers as they join the Royal Flying Corps when war breaks out.

programme.title: Sussex Fortnight
programme.desc: Made in 1950. By bicycle with Raymond Glendenning to Arundel, Littlehampton and a horse show, ending with the Goodwood Cup.

programme.title: Night Train to Paris
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Douglas. Stars Leslie Nielsen & Aliza Gur. A retired spy agrees to a friend's request to deliver a tape to Paris and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Instrument of War. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Andrew Keir & Charles Houston. Dan travels to Prisoner's Island to collect valuable cargo, however, the cargo is a single Scottish Highland Chief.

programme.title: The Young Land
programme.desc: 1959. Western. Director: Ted Tetzlaff. Stars Patrick Wayne, Yvonne Craig & Dennis Hopper. American gunslinger kills a Mexican man. He is arrested and the Hispanic population wait for justice.

programme.title: Oliver Twist (1982)
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Clive Donner. Stars George C. Scott, Tim Curry & Michael Hordern. The classic tale of an orphan boy who finds himself joining a band of thieves after escaping the orphanage.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1966. Infamous Conduct. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Dermot Walsh. A famous surgeon loses his license (and his wife) after a female patient accuses him of conduct unbecoming a physician. (S1, E12)

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Ted & Mrs Fox P1. Stars Russell Hunter, Madeline Smith and Maureen Pryor. In a world where nobody has the time to 'listen', people like Ted and Mrs Fox are lucky to find each other.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Ted & Mrs Fox P2. Stars Joyce Heron, Russell Hunter, Perry Balfour, Madeline Smith & Maureen Pryor. Mrs Fox and Ted are incurable romantics, clinging to memories of the past.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Fly Casting/The Log Splitter. 1986. Jack Hargreaves illustrates the technical advances in fly fishing. He then shows us his latest gadget for chopping logs for his wood burning stove.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Turncoat. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, David Daker & Forbes Collins. Spiker is ambushed whilst carrying a letter for Sir John Glutton, who then forces Dick Turpin to recover the message.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Enemy. Stars Barry Foster, Joanna Dunham & Nigel Stock. When Van der Valk and his wife Arlette receive death threats, the detective finds himself looking for a mysterious Enemy.

programme.title: An Innocent Man
programme.desc: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham & Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release.

programme.title: The Devil's Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Horror. Directed by William J. Hole Jr. Stars Linda Christian, Robert Alda & Ariadne Welter. A man, haunted by visions of a beautiful woman, winds up in a Satanic cult after meeting her.

programme.title: The Mark of Cain
programme.desc: 1947. Crime Drama. Directed by Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars Eric Portman, Sally Gray & Patrick Holt. A young French girl instigates rivalry between two brothers when she marries the younger one.

programme.title: Action Stations
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Cecil H. Williamson and starring Paul Carpenter and Mary Martin. A forger flees to Spain but his daughter is kidnapped by a gang.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Join the amazing Vince Taylor as he performs the entrancing hit Twenty Flight Rock.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Marker. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin's Nest. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Vito Scotti. The Penguin tries to get arrested as he wants to be sent back to prison so he can team up with a forger residing there.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Bird's Last Jest. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Alan Napier. Batman requests Alfred to go undercover, in an attempt to spring a trap on the Penguin and stop his latest scheme.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Sam Peckinpah, a hard-hitting director who had seen atrocities at the end of the war as a marine became known for his violent scenes, he is remembered as the man who reinvented the western.

programme.title: Demobbed
programme.desc: 1944. Comedy. Demobbed from the army, four troublesome soldiers are reunited with their old Sergeant. Starring Norman Evans, Nat Jackley and Dan Young. Directed by John E Blakely.

programme.title: The Widow From Chicago
programme.desc: 1930. Crime Drama. Directed by Edward F. Cline. Stars Alice White, Edward G. Robinson & Neil Hamilton. A woman infiltrates the mob in order to avenge her brother's death.

programme.title: The Breaking Point
programme.desc: 1961. The nephew of a printer gets involved with foreign spies' intent on making counterfeit money. Stars Peter Reynolds & Dermot Walsh.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Public Lives - Part 1. 1973. Stars Jim Norton, Jill Freud, Joseph Berry. A theatre director and a theatre producer face obscenity charges relating to a play they presented entitled 'Public Lives'.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Public Lives - Part 2. 1973. Stars Kevin Stoney, Brian Wilde & Jennifer Clulow. Actress Mandy Jenkins speaks about how she was sacked from the play and author E.W. Appleby makes a statement.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Public Lives - Part 3. 1973. Stars Jim Norton & Christopher Burgess. Jeremy Williams continues giving evidence and denies making an obscene production, and Anthony Standing MP provides his views.

programme.title: Pete Murray Takes You To Hastings 1981
programme.desc: Pete Murray takes you along his travels through the picturesque and historical coastal town of Hastings.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: Plain Sailing. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Jan Francis. Louisa turns the air blue when she buys a summer resort adjacent to a posh private club at Cowes.

programme.title: Profile
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director Francis Searle and starring John Bentley, Kathleen Byron and Thea Gregory. The editor of a magazine is keen on the boss's daughter but her mother is keen on him.

programme.title: Call Northside 777
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Henry Hathaway. Stars James Stewart, Richard Conte & Helen Walker. A Chicago reporter looks into an old murder and realises the man jailed for the crime is innocent.

programme.title: Look At Life Birdmen
programme.desc: 1963. A look at the origins of man-powered flight, focusing on John Wimpenny, the first man to pedal himself through the air for more than half a mile. Also featuring a look at today's attempts.

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: Fast Castle to Abb's Head. 1981. Tom takes the 5 mile trek from the remarkable Fast Castle, built on crags and reckoned to have been built for shipwrecking, to the popular destination of St Abbs.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: A Bad Mistake. 1974. Stars Hilary Tindall, Gabrielle Drake & Colin Baker. Ann fears losing everything. Meanwhile, Edward meets prospective shareholders, but his honesty causes a setback.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Saber at Sea. 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Ann Stephens & Robert Arden. Saber helps a woman who has turned amateur detective upon finding a dead body aboard a cruise ship.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 26. 1975. Ronnie Hilton sings a number of hits, New World perform 'Kara, Kara' and 'Sister Jane'. David Copperfield, Valentino and Jimmy Marshall also star.

programme.title: Unfaithfully Yours
programme.desc: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her.

programme.title: The Reckless Moment
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Director: Max Ophuls. Stars James Mason, Joan Bennett & Geraldine Brooks. Finding her daughter's lover dead, a housewife takes desperate measures to protect her family from scandal.

programme.title: Man Who Cheated Himself
programme.desc: 1950. Crime. Director: Felix E. Feist. Stars Lee J. Cobb, Jane Wyatt & John Dall. A homicide detective who witnesses his girlfriend kill her husband is assigned to the case, alongside his brother.

programme.title: Portraits of Terror
programme.desc: 1957. Horror. Directed by Ed Wood Jr. Stars James 'Duke' Moore, Dudley Manlove & Jeannie Stevens. An actor roams an empty theatre after dark, where he is haunted by creepy sounds and eerie sights.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Stage Door Johnnie. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Cicely Courtneidge. Kate Seymour is engaged to James Stratton, but she is receiving letters warning of his womanising.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Wimbledon Hastings? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. An exploding tennis ball kill a tennis star at a charity event. Time for Burke to investigate.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Cat's Meow. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward, Julie Newmar & Sharyn Wynters. Catwoman steals Chad and Jeremy's voices and holds them for ransom.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Bat's Kow Tow. 1966. Stars Adam West, Julie Newmar & Ric Roman. Batman and Robin rush to the Policeman's Ball where Chad and Jeremy are singing but Catwoman is already there to cause mayhem.

programme.title: The Marked One
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Director: Francis Searle. Stars William Lucas, Zena Walker & Patrick Jordan. Criminals kidnap a man's daughter in order to obtain forgery plates which they believe he possesses.

programme.title: The Agitator
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Director: John Harlow. Stars William Hartnell, Mary Morris & John Laurie. In this 'lost' William Hartnell film, a socialist inherits the British factory where he works as a union mechanic

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: Death on the Underground. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. The murder of 73 year old aristocrat Countess Teresa Lubienska on the eastbound Piccadilly line platform in 1957.

programme.title: Paid
programme.desc: 1930. Drama. Directed by Sam Wood. Stars Joan Crawford, Robert Armstrong & Marie Prevost. Mary Turner, a wrongly accused ex-convict, seeks revenge on those who sent her to prison.

programme.title: Inspector Hornleigh
programme.desc: 1938. Mystery. Directed by Eugene Forde. Stars Gordon Harker, Alastair Sim & Miki Hood. Inspector Hornleigh is called in to investigate a murder linked to the theft of government secrets.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1953. The Missing Man. Directed by Ken Hughes. Stars Tristan Rawson & Evelyn Moore. The Dream of a Retired Vicar's wife sets police on the trail of a man who has been missing since 1938. (S1, E02)

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Knight Who Came To Dinner. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Little John and Friar Tuck capture a knight, but are concerned about his value judging by his equipment.

programme.title: Doctor at Sea
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Brigitte Bardot, James Robertson. A young man signs up to be a ship's doctor in an effort to bring some excitement into his life.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Diamond Studded Malaria. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Bill Nagy. Bill Harrison has just been acquitted of murder. He was escorting diamonds to London but came down with malaria.

programme.title: A Family At War: Christmas Special
programme.desc: 1971. Salute The Happy Morn. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Mrs Porter discovers the truth about Margaret's illegitimate child. Sheila has designs on Colin. (S2, E17)

programme.title: Nowhere To Go
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directors: Seth Holt, Basil Dearden. Stars George Nader, Maggie Smith, Bernard Lee. Paul is released from jail, following a stretch for robbing a woman who falls for his charms.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. They All Sound Simple at First. Stars Alfred Burke, Peter Childs & Philip Madoc. Marker is called in by a cabinet-maker to recover £700 he's owed for an antique clock.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro as she introduces a unique live event - The Cellar Club Live, featuring fellow Scream Queens Madeline Smith and Judy Matheson.

programme.title: Cellar Club Live (Scream Queens)
programme.desc: 2026. Actress and novelist Linda Regan is joined by the fabulous Scream Queens Caroline Munro, Judy Matheson and Madeline Smith, and look into the psychology of horror with Katie Evans.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Before Caroline leaves tonight, let her tell you about the classic film coming up in next week's Cellar Club.

programme.title: Assault
programme.desc: 1971. Thriller. Director: Sidney Hayers. Stars Suzy Kendall, Frank Finlay, Freddie Jones. After two schoolgirls are assaulted in the woods, a teacher uses herself as bait to catch the perpetrator.

programme.title: Paul Oakenfold
programme.desc: Legendary DJ and producer Paul Oakenfold kicks off the weekend with three hours of the biggest tunes and stories from his extraordinary career.

programme.title: Natural Born Killers
programme.desc: Oliver Stone's controversial crime drama starring Woody Harrelson and Juliette Lewis. Psychopathic lovers Mickey and Mallory set out on a violent cross-country murder spree and become macabre media celebrities when the unrepentant Mickey annnounces that they're "natural born killers".

programme.title: What We Do in the Shadows
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jemaine Clement and Taika Waititi. Viago is a centuries-old vampire who shares a flat with three fellow bloodsuckers in present-day Wellington in New Zealand. The quartet struggles to fit into a modern world of paying rent and staying fashionable, until young Nick is turned into a vampire and decides to help them to adjust.

programme.title: Phantom Racer
programme.desc: When former friends and rival Nascar racers JJ SAWYER and CUTTER MCCONAUGHEY collide in a fiery accident on the track, only JJ survives. Sixteen years later, he is a guilt-ridden ‘truckie’ transporting race cars from track to track without a life. Unexpectedly stopping in his home town, JJ discovers that Cutter’s race car has been completely restored and now, because of JJ’s presence, it comes alive, haunted by its old driver. The car wants revenge and it wants JJ. Mile after brutal mile the highway becomes a battleground, resulting in a final confrontation which must bring an end to the frightening rampage of the Phantom Racer.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jonathan Haze and featuring Jack Nicholson. When dim-witted Seymour Krelboined develops a new breed of plant, his position at the Skid Row flower shop looks to be safe. The only problem is, his new creation craves human blood if it is to grow.

programme.title: Archie
programme.desc: Animated short. Archie is devastated to learn of the death of his beloved Aunt Betty and makes the long journey to the home she has left him in the Outer Hebrides

programme.title: A.R.C.H.I.E. 2 : Mission Impawsible
programme.desc: Super-smart A.I dog Archie (Michael J. Fox) befriends the son of a carnival owner while on a summer holiday. Family sequel.

programme.title: An Eskimo Tale
programme.desc: When animals start mysteriously disappearing, three young Inuits embark on a perilous journey to save their tribe from ruin. Animated adventure, with the voice of Christopher Plummer

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne and Gail Russell. Pursued by armed horsemen, wounded and exhausted, hard-bitten outlaw Quirt Evans finds refuge on the ranch of a devout Quaker family. As he is nursed back to health, Quirt finds himself torn between his growing love for Quaker girl Penelope and the lure of an old score still to be settled.

programme.title: Somewhere in Time
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Christopher Reeve and Jane Seymour. A cryptic message from an elderly lady and a captivating photograph from 1912 lead playwright Richard Collier to travel back through time in search of the beautiful Elise McKenna. There is, however, no guarantee that his heart's desire is attainable.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romantic comedy thriller starring Cary Grant, Audrey Hepburn and Walter Matthau. The body of a man hurtles from the carriage of a train speeding across the French countryside, and for Regina Lampert life becomes bewildering. It also becomes sinister when she returns to Paris to find her flat stripped bare. Who is telling the truth, and whom can she trust?

programme.title: Fixing Up Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Natalie Dreyfuss and Marshall Williams. Corporate party planner Joy is hired to help a young CEO with his festive jamboree. As they get to know each other, she finds she can "fix up" other areas of his life, too.

programme.title: Christmas on Holly Lane
programme.desc: Drama starring Sarah Lancaster, Karen Holness and Gina Holden. Three friends with troubled lives who meet every year for Christmas fear this might be their last together.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Historical thriller based on events surrounding the assassination of President John F Kennedy, starring Kevin Costner. On 22 November 1963, President Kennedy's death changes America for ever. Initially, an angry and saddened nation is satisfied with the guilt of Lee Harvey Oswald. But, as the years pass, unease, disillusionment and cynicism set in. New Orleans prosecutor Jim Garrison is convinced of a conspiracy, and sets out to prove it.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Drama about a man whose quiet life running a video store is turned upside down by a beautiful and adventurous woman

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: An attorney is obsessively focused on her career, but is forced to rethink her life when her husband unexpectedly leaves her. She finds herself forced to contend with the daily grind of her family's lives, and finds an unexpected new strength as she struggles to hold them together. Drama, starring Mary Elizabeth Winstead and Don Johnson

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Edy Ganem and Brendon Zub. A dressmaker who makes a living by upcycling second-hand wedding gowns discovers that fixing her love life is a trickier task.

programme.title: A Wizard's Tale
programme.desc: A teenage lad is transported to a magical land, where he teams up with a princess to stop a mean wizard called The Grump who casts a spell to banish happiness from the area. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Toby Kebbell, Lily Collins and Ian McShane

programme.title: An Eskimo Tale
programme.desc: When animals start mysteriously disappearing, three young Inuits embark on a perilous journey to save their tribe from ruin. Animated adventure, with the voice of Christopher Plummer

programme.title: A Christmas Story
programme.desc: The perfect Christmas story for all the family. Join eight-year old Julius as he embarks on a magical journey! Growing up in an orphanage, Julius has always been a bit of an outsider. However, one day he is wondrously transported to a frosty and enchanted world where, with the help of Herman the marzipan pig and Sophina the glass angel, he sets off to save Santa from the wicked hands of Crampus.

programme.title: Eagle's Wing
programme.desc: Western starring Martin Sheen and Sam Waterston. 1840s: City-bred trapper Pike learns to survive in hostile terrain following his companion's death at the hands of a tribal war party. But his ownership of a magnificent white stallion - the Eagle's Wing - brings him into deadly conflict with White Bull, a Kiowa warrior.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: Classic thriller starring Margaret Lockwood and Michael Redgrave. One moment Miss Froy was sitting there, on the London-bound train from the Tyrol. The next she had vanished. Some passengers claimed she was never there, but Iris Henderson is convinced that she saw her. Was it her imagination?

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: Romantic drama based on Colleen McCullough's bestselling novel, starring Piper Laurie and Mel Gibson. Tim is a picture of sheer physical beauty, a mild-mannered 24-year-old whom Mary Horton longs to take under her wing. The problem is that Mary is a woman in her 40s and Tim has a child-like IQ. What will everyone think if they have a relationship?

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ashley Jones and David Blue. A photographer uses his new-found wealth to act as a secret Santa to his community, and his acts of kindness bring him close to a single mother.

programme.title: Christmas Hero
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Anna Hutchison. When firefighter Jenny falls in love with Tom she gets caught in the middle of a custody battle between Tom and his bitter ex-wife.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Spoof of 300 and other historic battle movies, starring Sean Maguire and Carmen Electra. King Leonidas of Sparta leads his men in a battle against troops led by Persian ruler Xerxes, while Leonidas's wife, Queen Margo, makes her own war effort.

programme.title: Buster
programme.desc: Crime drama based on the life of Great Train Robber Buster Edwards, starring Phil Collins and Julie Walters. A small-time crook gets the chance to move into the big time when he becomes part of a gang planning to rob the Royal Mail train of more than £2 million - a crime that will go down in history.

programme.title: Lady Chatterley's Lover
programme.desc: She was beautiful and sensual, trapped in a loveless marriage. He was her husband's servant. Born into worlds as far apart, they found a passionate world of their own.

programme.title: Blood In The Water
programme.desc: A young, guilt-ridden woman is forced into a game of Russian roulette with a great white shark and others who have escaped the law. Horror.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: When a young woman called Lily returns to her hometown to help her Aunt Maggie run a bed and breakfast, she meets Marcus, a handsome pilot. Romantic drama, starring Morgan Kohan, Marcus Rosner, Brenda Matthews and Emma Cam

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
programme.desc: Two new students at nearby Belmont University, Ryan and Molly, meet the first day of classes and become study partners. The Bridge, a local bookstore, becomes a close part of their lives as their relationship grows.

programme.title: The Christmas Cure
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Brooke Nevin. A woman returns to her home town for Christmas before taking up a job promotion at the hospital where she works. But personal and family circumstances make her think twice about ever going back.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Comedy western starring John Wayne and Maureen O'Hara. McLintock is a ranch owner who hires Louise Warren to cook for him and help around the house. Her son Devlin is also taken on as a ranch hand. Everything seems to be working out fine until McLintock's estranged wife returns from back East, seeking a divorce and custody of their teenage daughter.

programme.title: Radio Rebel
programme.desc: Timid schoolgirl Tara tries to hide her double life as the author of a daily podcast. Her father, the boss of a popular radio station, encourages her to host a live show in the studio, and the broadcast becomes a big hit with her fellow pupils. However, the school's strict principal disapproves and takes action to silence her. Drama, starring Debby Ryan, Sarena Parmar and Adam di Marco

programme.title: A Cinderella Christmas
programme.desc: Romance starring Emma Rigby and Peter Porte. Put-upon party planner Angie meets handsome bachelor Nikolaus at a masked ball. But after she leaves without telling him who she is, Nikolaus is determined to track her down.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, a stubborn, difficult, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: Before You Say I Do
programme.desc: Fantasy romantic comedy starring David Sutcliffe and Jennifer Westfeldt. George is deeply in love with Jane, but she's reluctant to walk down the aisle again because her first marriage ended badly. Then George is given the chance to change Jane's view of matrimony when he's propelled back in time.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Comedy starring Spencer Tracy, Joan Bennett and Elizabeth Taylor. Stanley Banks is looking forward to some peace and quiet now that his daughter is married. But his plans are disrupted when she announces that she is going to have a baby.

programme.title: A Little Something for Your Birthday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Sharon Stone and Tony Goldwyn. Senna's life has not turned out how she had hoped. But, every year on her birthday, her lack of career and romantic success weighs more and more heavily, and her 50th is approaching...

programme.title: Sirens
programme.desc: Erotic comedy starring Hugh Grant, Tara FitzGerald and Sam Neill. Australia, the 1930s: when a controversial painting planned to be exhibited by artist Norman Lindsay offends the church, a young vicar who has just arrived from England is sent to Lindsay's home to try to persuade him to withdraw the work.

programme.title: Deadly Dormitory
programme.desc: When a University student refuses to sleep with her professor in exchange for good grades, she's in danger of being killed to keep her quiet, and her mother must drop everything to save her. Romantic drama, starring Grace Patterson

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: A family finds they have been burgled, but are unaware the intruder is lurking in their attic with further terror in mind. Thriller, with Jeremy Sisto, Kate Ashfield (Shaun of the Dead) and Ryan Simpkins

programme.title: The Wedding Ring
programme.desc: At her sister's wedding, jewellery designer Kate encounters her childhood sweetheart. Will she finally see a ring slipped on her own finger? Romantic drama, starring Lauren Lee Smith and Dillon Casey

programme.title: An En Vogue Christmas
programme.desc: Desperate to save her late father's legacy when his club is foreclosed on, Kendall and her friends put on a Christmas concert to keep it in business. Drama, starring Terry Ellis, Cindy Herron, Rhona Bennett and Genelle Williams

programme.title: Nine Lives of Christmas
programme.desc: After a stray cat adopts Zachary, he meets Marilee and realizes the single life is not as fulfilling as he thought it was.

programme.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: Romantic drama based on an Ernest Hemingway short story, starringGregory Peck, Susan Hayward and Ava Gardner. A writer looks back on his varied life and the women he has loved as he lies badly injured in a camp site beneath the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro.

programme.title: A Time to Dance
programme.desc: Determined not to spoil their daughter's wedding, a couple postpone their separation and try to put aside their differences for the big day. Drama based on Karen Kingsbury's novel, starring Jennie Garth, Corbin Bernsen and Fiona Vroom

programme.title: A Fairytale Christmas
programme.desc: Aka Christmas Belle. With her California hometown in the rearview mirror, Belle heads north on business to facilitate the estate sale of a mansion. While the job is a dream, the client, Hunter Lowell, is not. But, as the two spend more time together, his icy demeanour begins to melt. Although their relationship is budding, Belle's long-time suitor, Tony, arrives, sending mixed signals to Hunter while adding chaos to the holiday season.

programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: Marley's brilliant at organizing other people's engagements, but unlucky in finding romance herself. When designing her most important proposal yet, the man who could jeopardize it all may be the one who helps find her own love story.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Adventure comedy starring Telly Savalas, Robert Culp and James Mason. An ex-PoW returns to Germany 30 years after the Second World War and teams up with his former prison camp commander to find a wartime cache of gold. But only one man knows where it is - a Nazi war criminal who is in a high-security prison. An elaborate plan is hatched to kidnap him and force him to reveal the whereabouts of the gold.

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 1990, and when teenager Sarah is transported beyond the TV screen and into her most played game, she finds herself trapped on intergalactic prison planet Heinous, home to the most dangerous villains in the galaxy, including the bizarre Revengor and evil sorceress Shee. The only way to escape is to complete the levels. Teaming up with space hero, Max Cloud, they must take on terrifying tyrants with a little help from her not-so-savvy best friend, Cowboy, controlling the console from her bedroom. Sci-fi comedy, starring Scott Adkins, John Hannah and Lashana Lynch

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: A no-nonsense survivalist tools up and takes the fight to invading extra-terrestrial hordes. Sci-fi thriller, starring Wesley Snipes, RJ Mitte and Jedidiah Goodacre

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: A dead soldier who was brought back to life as the ultimate killing machine is revived once more to deal with terrorists who have taken control of a nuclear reactor. He finds his enemies not only have a more advanced reanimated soldier in their ranks, but they have also resurrected an old foe of his. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Jean-Claude Van Damme and Dolph Lundgren

programme.title: Tower of Evil
programme.desc: Archaeologists are searching for the tomb of an ancient chieftain on a remote and spooky island when a merciless maniac strikes, attacking their party over and over again. Horror, starring Jill Haworth, Bryant Halliday, Jack Watson and Anna Palk

programme.title: Women and Men: Stories of Seduction
programme.desc: Three short stories, each focused on a man and a woman. In 'The Man in a Brooks Brothers Suit,' a businessman pursues a woman aboard a train. In 'Dusk Before Fireworks,' a flapper's romantic evening is interrupted by constant phone calls. In 'Hills Like White Elephants,' a couple discusses the woman's pregnancy while traveling in Spain.

programme.title: Second Chorus
programme.desc: When perennial college students Danny O'Neill (Fred Astaire) & Hank Taylor (Burgess Meredith) are forced to make it on their own, the pair get jobs with Artie Shaw's band and reunite with ex-manager Ellen Miller (Paulette Goddard). Remastered for 4K UHD

programme.title: A Family for the Holidays
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Erin Krakow. Affairs of the heart and an old family secret threaten to scupper the plans of a woman flying to her home town at Christmas.

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Erin Krakow. Christmas has always been painful for Miranda who has no family to spend it with. But when the opportunity to find her father arises, it brings a couple of surprises, including the possibility of new love.

programme.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
programme.desc: All-star film version of Lewis Carroll's classic children's fantasy featuring Peter Sellers, Spike Milligan and Michael Crawford, with Fiona Fullerton as Alice.

programme.title: Dreamchild
programme.desc: Fantasy drama starring Coral Browne and Ian Holm. April 1932: attending the Lewis Carroll Centenary in New York, 80-year-old Alice Hargreaves - the inspiration for "Alice in Wonderland" - becomes increasingly haunted by her childhood memories of the strange and repressed Reverend Charles Dodgson.

programme.title: A Gift for Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ali Liebert and Peter Porte. A woman who hits a man with her bike, causing him to lose his memory, is determined to find out more about this handsome stranger.

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: A member of a chocolate-making duo is preparing for a high profile contest, when her partner in the kitchen abruptly pulls out. She soon finds a new creative partner in a chance meeting with a single father, and while working on their sweet creations, they each find the missing ingredient in their lives. Romantic comedy, with Rhiannon Fish and Jesse Hutch

programme.title: Somewhere Tomorrow
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Sarah Jessica Parker. A fatherless teenage girl is befriended by the ghost of a young man who died in an aircrash. She finds herself falling in love with the ghost, and has to choose between staying with him in his ghost world, or returning to what remains of her family on Earth.

programme.title: BMX Bandits
programme.desc: Adventure starring Nicole Kidman. Three teenage BMX bikers discover a stash of stolen two-way radios. Unaware that the radios belong to bank robbers, they begin selling them to their friends. This creates havoc with local police radio frequencies and sends the robbers in pursuit of the bike-riding youngsters.

programme.title: The Man with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: Drama starring Frank Sinatra and Kim Novak. Chicago: card dealer and heroin addict Frankie Machine has just got out of jail. He returns to his old haunts determined to kick his habits and become a musician. But the pressures of dealing with a wife in a wheelchair, a pusher and the woman he really loves make things tough.

programme.title: The Holcroft Covenant
programme.desc: Spy thriller starring Michael Caine and Anthony Andrews. New York architect Noel Holcroft has had to live with the knowledge that his natural father, now dead, was a leading Nazi. One day he is summoned to Geneva and given a letter written by his father 40 years earlier. The contents of the letter, referring to his father's covenant, are to change his life.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: Action drama starring Samuel L Jackson and Kevin Spacey. Police hostage negotiator Danny Roman is informed by his partner that some of their colleagues are embezzling funds. When his partner is murdered, suspicion falls on Roman and he realises that he must take drastic action to clear his name.

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Amanda Schull and Morgan David Jones. A journalist faces a dilemma when she finds herself on a yoga retreat with a handsome guy who happens to be involved in a scandal she's investigating.

programme.title: Girlfriends of Christmas Past
programme.desc: Three women who share the same unfaithful ex-boyfriend conspire to get revenge on him during a Christmas gathering. However, one of them falls in love with the event planner organising the party, and is torn between her feelings for him and her loyalty to her friends. Romantic comedy, starring Tammin Sursok and Carter Bolton

programme.title: Love Always, Santa
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Marguerite Moreau and Mike Faiola. Widow Celia has dedicated her whole life to young daughter Lilly. But Lilly doesn't want her mother to spend another Christmas alone and so writes a letter to Santa asking for Celia to be happy again.

programme.title: The People That Time Forgot
programme.desc: An explorer braves encounters with dinosaurs as he leads an expedition to the mysterious island prehistoric island to rescue his marooned naval officer friend from a forgotten civilisation. Fantasy adventure sequel to The Land that Time Forgot, starring Patrick Wayne, Doug McClure and Sarah Douglas

programme.title: The Gold Rush
programme.desc: A prospector seeks shelter in a cabin during a fierce snowstorm and gets involved in an altercation with the two men already huddled inside. Silent comedy, starring Charlie Chaplin, with Tom Murray and Mack Swain

programme.title: Love Strikes Twice
programme.desc: An unhappily married woman takes a fresh look at love after she has an accident on the way to see a divorce lawyer and wakes up with amnesia. Romantic drama, starring Katrina Begin and Tilky Jones

programme.title: Forever in My Heart
programme.desc: While in Ireland on an internship, Jenna falls in love with the Charlie, the son of the owner of the hotel she has been assigned to, but they end up going their separate ways. Five years later, she returns to Ireland and bumps into Charlie again - and it's immediately clear that they still have feelings for one another. Romantic drama, starring Merritt Patterson and Jack Turner

programme.title: The Assassination Bureau
programme.desc: Period black comedy starring Oliver Reed and Diana Rigg. Europe, 1906: the Assassination Bureau is a secret society that only kills people who really deserve it. A mysterious, beautiful woman decides to put out a contract - for the head of the bureau himself.

programme.title: Behind the Wall
programme.desc: The horrible truth about the past is slowly unveiled about the murder of Katelyn’s mother when her body is discovered in an abandoned lighthouse undergoing redevelopment. Contains some violent content.

programme.title: The Client
programme.desc: Thriller based on the novel by John Grisham, starring Susan Sarandon, Tommy Lee Jones and Brad Renfro. Young Mark Sway attracts the attention of both the law and the Mafia when he inadvertently witnesses the suicide of a Mob defence lawyer. The lawyer has passed on to Mark the location of a murdered senator, information that makes the boy and his family a target for sinister forces. Realising he needs protection, Mark enlists the help of attorney Reggie Love.

programme.title: Casablanca Express
programme.desc: A British commando is appointed as Winston Churchill's personal bodyguard, but soon has his work cut out for him when Nazi soldiers hijack a train transporting the prime minister to a vital strategic conference. Second World War thriller, starring Jason Connery and Donald Pleasence

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Christian Bale, Steve Carell, Ryan Gosling and Brad Pitt. United States, 2006: eccentric Wall Street whizzkid Michael Burry realises that the US mortgage market is heading towards a crash and begins to bet against it. This activity attracts the attention of trader Jared Vennett and idealistic hedge-fund expert Mark Baum who begin to suspect that the system could be about to collapse.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Classic drama starring Janet Gaynor and Fredric March. Declining Hollywood movie star Norman Maine meets young waitress Esther Blodgett at a party and promises to make her a star. But as her career goes from strength to strength, Maine's continues to go downhill.

programme.title: Married by Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring April Bowlby and Jes Macallan. When two sisters discover that their father's company will be inherited by whichever one marries first, the sister who has worked to build the business begins a frantic search for a husband.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Claire Coffee and Ryan McPartlin. Young executive Holly Maddux wakes after a fall to find that the hunky mannequin she admired in a department store window has come to life and is by her side. Love blossoms, but Holly soon discovers that being perfect all the time is hard work.

programme.title: Modern Times
programme.desc: Comedy starring Charlie Chaplin. A factory worker becomes so unhinged by his menial job that he winds up in hospital. Following his release and a spell in jail, he befriends a young orphan woman and falls in love.

programme.title: Cup of Love
programme.desc: A food scientist is sent to Colombia, where she meets a local plantation owner who is reluctant to work with her at first, but slowly romance blossoms. Romantic drama, starring Anna Hutchison, Nikolás Rincón and David Ojalvo

programme.title: A Puppy for Christmas
programme.desc: A woman loses her job, her flat and her boyfriend just before Christmas - all thanks to her mischievous pet dog. A co-worker invites her to come and spend the holiday with him on his farm, and the experience leaves her torn between pursuing a new life in the country or trying to rebuild her old city life. Festive romantic comedy, starring Cindy Busby, Greyston Holt and Christopher Russell

programme.title: Candid about Love
programme.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer’s Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn’t taken a new photo in ten years, she’s determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.

programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble
programme.desc: Offbeat drama about a youngster forced to live in a sterile isolation unit because he was born with no natural immunity to disease. Starring John Travolta, Robert Reed and Buzz Aldrin

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Classic drama starring Janet Gaynor and Fredric March. Declining Hollywood movie star Norman Maine meets young waitress Esther Blodgett at a party and promises to make her a star. But as her career goes from strength to strength, Maine's continues to go downhill.

programme.title: Giant Killer Ants
programme.desc: From FrightFest Presents. Tremors meets Spinal Tap in this excell-ant monster movie with bite. Starring Sean Astin (Stranger Things) and Tom Arnold. A 1989 'one-hit-wonder' glam-metal band embark on a trip to the No-chella rock festival in the hopes for a comeback. But a carefree psychedelic pit stop results in them facing an army of flesh-eating ants that keep increasing in size! A must see!

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Martial arts drama starring Bruce Lee. Karate pupil Chen Chen returns to Shanghai for the funeral of his former teacher. When he discovers that his mentor was in fact murdered, Chen sets out to avenge his death.
